known_deviations.source: ICLR 2023 TimesNet; the period-based 2D reshaping, Inception blocks, embedding and the anomaly-detection normalization are transcribed from github.com/thuml/Time-Series-Library (models/TimesNet.py, layers/Conv_Blocks.py, layers/Embed.py, exp/exp_anomaly_detection.py).
known_deviations.hyperparameter_note: Per-dataset budgets come from the release's scripts/anomaly_detection/<dataset>/TimesNet.sh. SWaT ships eight configurations there (d_model 8-64 x e_layers 2-3); d_model 64 with three layers is used here and the sweep is recorded as a known degree of freedom.

boundary: Full local baseline comparison, not historical author-harness equivalence; original known deviations remain explicit. USAD signed-loss control may be unstable and must be reported as such.
